images.subject: Inside a huge open mining gallery carved into grey rock, a thick vein of gleaming silvery raw metal ore runs diagonally across the rock wall, freshly exposed by large far-future drilling machines.

images.subject: A small far-future colony of domes and towers on a grey rocky plain, seen from a distance under a violent solar storm: huge shimmering curtains of green and violet aurora and bright solar flares fill the sky.
images.detail: Arcs of blue electricity crackle along the colony's power lines and pylons.
images.mood: Art direction: realistic sci-fi concept art, dramatic and ominous mood, dark stormy sky, harsh contrasting light with deep shadows, muted cold palette.

images.subject: A huge gutted far-future cruiser warship wreck slowly tumbling in orbit, its hull torn open, with cargo containers visible inside its open holds.

images.subject: Ancient ruins of a vanished alien civilization, half-buried in the grey rock and freshly unearthed by a far-future excavation site: tall weathered monolithic arches and carved stone structures of a strange, non-human design.

images.subject: A wide crater in the grey rock where dozens of huge boulders and rock slabs float motionless in mid-air above the crater floor, defying gravity, some of them several storeys high.
